title.narrative: Integrated Rurban Development and Climate Resilience Project

description.narrative: The development objective of Integrated Rurban Development and Climate Resilience Project for Sri Lanka is to increase productivity, market access, and climate resilience of agri-food producers in selected areas. This project has five components. The first component, Promotion of Climate-Smart Production, Value Addition, and Inclusive Access to Markets, has the following sub-components: (i) Capacity Building and Development of Horizontal and Vertical Alliances; Improved Market Integration for Increased Climate-Smart Production and Value Addition; and Strengthening Private Sector Provision of Agri-services through Innovation and Entrepreneurship. The second component, Integrated Management of Natural Resources for Climate Resilience, has the following sub-components: Improving Cascade Management and On-Farm Water Use Efficiency; Irrigation and Water Resources Management; and Boosting Climate Smart Agriculture Technologies and Practices. The third component, Strengthening the Enabling Environment for Sectoral Growth, has the following sub-components: Better Quality and Availability of Agriculture Data; Quality Infrastructure Improvements; and Enhancing Provision of Agricultural Insurance. The fourth component, Project Management, Monitoring and Learning, will support the overall management, implementation, and supervision of project interventions; capacity building; and monitoring, evaluation, communication, dissemination, and continuous learning throughout the life of the project. The fifth component, Contingent Emergency Response Component, will allow for swift reallocation of unallocated credit proceeds from the other components to provide emergency recovery support following an eligible crisis or emergency.
